allocation_peak_scope: Separate tracemalloc peak for each complete solve plus JSON serialization at 10 iterations/delay 5; verify original-world metrics after tracing. Python-traced allocations only, not RSS or high-iteration memory.
interpretation: Candidate replaces only the delayed adapter's imported strategy alias with direct normalization of its CFR+-clamped nonnegative regret rows. Exact output equality and quality checks are mandatory. Timing is a three-pair whole-call comparison; promotion requires at least a 5% median reduction. Any changed loop or allocation accounting requires a separate public-vector admission review.
model_limits: Same fixed weighted fixture as the prior profile: finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop-checkdown game, three exact private combos per player, two selected flops and 27,720 physical worlds; one shared 10-chip stack; forced checkdown after flop betting. Not broad-range/full-deck, all-streets, multiway, unrestricted NLHE, or a general convergence claim.
promotion_gate_rule: Exact payload parity and quality target on every timing arm; candidate faster in all three paired runs; median reduction at least 5%; separate candidate traced peak no more than 1.01 times baseline. The traced-peak condition is only a nonregression gate, not evidence of an RSS or general memory gain.
